songs.title: Screen Shot
songs.description: Explore Maketa’s 5:29 fan MIDI arrangement. Click a section to follow the repeating figure, bass, guitars, mallets and drums as layers enter and drop away.
songs.credit: Maketa · Online Sequencer fan arrangement
songs.review: Draft structure of the downloaded 5:29 fan arrangement, based on actual MIDI instrument entries, rests and returns. It has no source section markers or vocal track; completeness and alignment with the original recording are unverified. The export’s 142 BPM and 3/4 meter are preserved. Chord and key analysis remain pending.

sections.label: Opening figure
sections.description: The low synth repeats D–A–D. It continues unchanged while later parts build around it.

sections.label: Bass groove
sections.description: Bass enters above the low figure. A high percussion part starts at beat 169.5, before the larger ensemble enters.

sections.label: Full groove
sections.description: Distorted guitar, xylophone, vibraphone and the main kit enter together. Follow their different rhythmic patterns over the repeating low figure.

sections.label: Stripped groove
sections.description: The vibraphone and separate hi-hat layer drop out. Bass, guitar, xylophone and the main percussion continue.

sections.label: Guitar layer
sections.description: A clean-guitar part joins the existing groove. The opening synth figure remains underneath.

sections.label: Mallet return
sections.description: Vibraphone returns alongside the xylophone. The distorted-guitar part becomes busier toward the end of this section.

sections.label: Breakdown
sections.description: The opening synth stops. Guitars, mallets and the main bass rest; slap bass enters with the continuing kit.

sections.label: Bass return
sections.description: The main bass returns alongside slap bass and drums. Guitars and mallets remain absent.

sections.label: Full layers return
sections.description: Both guitar parts and both mallet parts return together; the original synth stays out. The pitched parts deliver their final hit at beat 768, then the drums finish at beat 777.5.
